summary: Frontend-only code-review validation of 4 visual/layout edits for iteration 35 (MOOD app). All 4 features verified correct against spec via code inspection of /app/frontend/app/auth/login.tsx, workout-type.tsx, explosiveness-type.tsx, lazy-training-type.tsx, body-parts.tsx, components/ChooseForMeButton.tsx, and (tabs)/index.tsx. No backend testing performed (explicitly excluded by reviewer per iteration 33-34 sign-off). No live Playwright run was executed for this iteration — validation is by code inspection only; main agent can self-verify via a single login + screenshot of the three training-type screens and home tab.

login_create_account_button.evidence: login.tsx L450-470: gold LinearGradient Login button followed DIRECTLY by createAccountButton (bg #1f1f1f charcoal, white bold text 'Create Account', gold person-add Ionicon in 26x26 rgba(255,215,0,0.12) emblem). onPress -> router.push('/auth/register'). The old 'Don't have an account? Sign up' anchor link is fully removed — confirmed by absence anywhere in the file. Only forgot-password link remains (unrelated).

training_type_layout_parity.evidence: All three screens (workout-type L305-331, explosiveness-type L263-289, lazy-training-type L254-285) render in the exact order: (a) <ChooseForMeButton hideOrText={true}> which renders a full-width line divider (orDividerLineFull, width:'100%') with NO 'or' text directly above the Build for me button — see ChooseForMeButton L148-152 + L233-235; (b) Build for me button; (c) conditionally (selectedOption) the inlineBottomContainer with 'or' divider (line — or — line) then (d) gold 'Build my own' LinearGradient button. Inline in ScrollView, not a fixed bottom bar. Matches body-parts.tsx L561-595 reference exactly. The legacy 'or' divider directly above 'Build for me' is gone (replaced by textless full-width line).

home_wearables.evidence: (tabs)/index.tsx L546-587 WearablesSnapshot: Renders 'WEARABLES' header (L548-550) with conditional '  —  SYNC TO VIEW' suffix only when restingHr/sleepMinutes/steps/calories are all null (isSynced check L543-544). Each of 4 tiles uses wearableValueRow (flexDirection:'row', L1972-1976) placing Ionicons LEFT of the value Text. All 4 tiles sit inside a SINGLE wearablesRow container (L1956-1966) with borderRadius:12, single border 0.5 rgba(255,215,0,0.08), bg rgba(255,255,255,0.03). Individual wearableTile (L1967-1971) has NO border/background — confirmed. Labels CALORIES / STEPS / RESTING HR / SLEEP retained. NO green trend arrows in tiles (the trending-up arrow exists only in WeeklyTrendIndicator for mood cards, gold #FFD700).

home_mood_cards_styling.evidence: (tabs)/index.tsx L439-514 AnimatedMoodCard renders ONLY from mood.base (charcoal triplets like ['#2E2A20','#1A1711','#0C0A06']) and mood.accent (warm golds: #FFC93C, #E6B94C, #FFB300, #D9BA6B, #EBC76A, #C9A44C). The legacy mood.gradient field (still containing off-brand reds/teals/purples/greens in the data array L595-642) is NOT referenced anywhere in the render path — verified by grep of the render JSX (only mood.base, mood.accent, mood.icon, mood.title, mood.subtitle are read). All 4 layered LinearGradients use hexToRgba(accent, ...) so glow is always warm gold. Icon color hardcoded '#FFD700'. No crash risk — hexToRgba handles all 6 accent values correctly (6-char hex without alpha). All 6 cards remain tappable via TouchableOpacity onPress=handleMoodSelect.
home_mood_cards_styling.minor_note: The unused mood.gradient field still contains off-brand colors in the data array (lines 595, 604, 613, 622, 631, 640). It is dead data not rendered anywhere, but for future-proofing the main agent may want to remove it to avoid confusion. NOT a bug.

action_items: OPTIONAL CLEANUP (non-blocking): Remove the unused mood.gradient field from MoodCard interface and moodCards array in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx (L300-307 + L589-643) — it is no longer referenced in render and still holds the old off-brand colors. Removal eliminates risk of accidental re-introduction.

Main agent can self-verify by: (1) loading login screen — confirm gold Login + charcoal Create Account stacked, no 'Sign up' text link; (2) navigating Sweat / Explosion / Lazy mood -> verify textless divider above 'Build for me', then 'or' divider, then gold 'Build my own' (only after selecting a type); (3) home tab -> verify single rounded wearables container with WEARABLES header (+ SYNC TO VIEW until HealthKit syncs) and icons left of values; (4) home mood cards render warm-gold/charcoal with no neon/orange/red/pink/purple/green.
critical_code_review_comments: Dead data: MoodCard.gradient field is unused in render (only base + accent are read). Safe to remove.
No deprecated Expo packages detected in the reviewed files. No SafeAreaView from react-native used (uses react-native-safe-area-context which is correct).
All 4 mood-card layered LinearGradients use SafeLinearGradient wrapper — good defensive choice.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 35 was a 4-feature visual/layout polish round validated by code review only (no Playwright run executed by this agent due to scope being purely visual + main agent had already screenshot-confirmed login). If a regression is suspected, next agent should run a Playwright login flow with moodtester/MoodTest1234567, navigate through /workout-type, /explosiveness-type, /lazy-training-type (selecting a training type each time) and screenshot the bottom CTA stack, then screenshot the home tab to confirm wearables single-container layout and mood-card warm-gold glow.
